items.title: Tech takes a beating as AI trade comes unstuck despite Anthropic surge
items.summary: Tech firms led losses across Asia once again Friday as Anthropic's sparkling debut failed to muster a recovery in sentiment towards the AI trade, with nerves frayed by worries over crisis-hit Nvidia, profitability and regulation."Whether Anthropic's IPO proves to be a defining moment for the AI trade remains to be seen.

items.title: How High Can ANT Stock Go? Wall Street Debut Sparks Valuation Debate – One Analyst Sees Amazon-Google Scale Opportunity In Anthropic
items.summary: William Blair called the IPO valuation “very reasonable” and said a higher sales multiple could put shares at $130 to $150.

items.title: Nvidia Backed AI Data Center Demand Puts Schneider Electric Stock In Focus
items.summary: AI returned to center stage when Anthropic’s IPO created about $81.3b in equity value and attracted heavyweight backers such as Nvidia, Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. That level of capital directed toward compute and power can draw attention to the less flashy picks and shovels behind the AI boom. This piece looks at three stocks exposed to that story and explains why their AI data center connections might matter for a diversified portfolio. The three stocks covered next are only a small...

items.title: Peter Thiel Now Has as Much Money in an Argentine Oil Stock as in Amazon. It’s Down 23% Since September 30
items.summary: Peter Thiel's hedge fund bought 697,043 more shares of Vista Energy last quarter, and on September 30 its $123.3 million stake in the Argentine shale driller matched its $123.3 million in Amazon to within $24,583. Brent crude has fallen 25% from its October 30 price since, and Vista 23% since September 30. Here is what Vista is and why an investor might bet on Vaca Muerta.

items.title: Is Your VOO Fund Secretly An AI Bet?
items.summary: Most people treat an S&P 500 index fund as the safe default. The AI sell-off reads like a tech-stock story that index owners can watch from the side. The fund's own holdings say otherwise. About one dollar in four in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) sits in six AI giants.

items.title: Anthropic’s Margins Will Be “Probably Better Than a Hyperscaler,” Says Its Most Bullish Analyst. Here’s What That Takes
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic opened 34% above its $83 IPO price in its Nasdaq debut today, and Melius initiated coverage with a Buy and a $155 target. Melius’s Ben Reitzes expects Anthropic’s margins to eventually beat a hyperscaler’s, where Amazon’s and Alphabet’s clouds and Microsoft earn operating margins from 36% to nearly 50%.

items.title: Anthropic Just Went Public at $1.5 Trillion. VOO Won’t Own a Share Until Late 2027 at the Earliest
items.summary: Millions of retirement savers assume their S&P 500 fund just picked up the year's biggest IPO. Two index rules, and a mountain of red ink on Anthropic's books, say otherwise. Here's what actually stands between your portfolio and the debut.

items.title: Amazon Urges NYC Customers to Oppose Mamdani-Backed Delivery Bill
items.summary: Online shoppers got a pop-up warning of a $5 fee per order if the legislation passes, escalating the company’s battle with City Hall.
